description: Create a private reusable DesignForYou template from a structured brief. The returned template_id works immediately with get_text_fields and generate. This stores a user-owned template in the canonical catalog collection; it does not publish it to the anonymous gallery.

base_prompt.description: Visual subject, style, and data-rendering requirements; plain layout text only.
base_prompt.title: Base Prompt

category.description: Supported category: Infographics, Instagram Posts, Instagram Stories, App Store Previews, Logos, Visual Novel, Cinematic Stills, Comic Panels, Living Panels Comics, Character References, Architecture Diagrams, or Developer Tools.
category.title: Category

height.description: Canvas height in pixels, matching aspect_ratio.
height.title: Height

layout_rules.description: Stable layout hierarchy and chart/diagram rules; plain text only.
layout_rules.title: Layout Rules

name.description: Reusable template name; repeated identical names are idempotent.
name.title: Name

text_fields.description: Editable copy fields returned by get_text_fields.

key.description: Stable snake_case field key, e.g. headline
key.title: Key

max_length.description: Maximum copy length for this field
max_length.title: Max Length

text_fields.title: Text Fields

width.description: Canvas width in pixels, matching aspect_ratio.
width.title: Width

name: create_template
title: Create private reusable template
